title: Nonnegativity of the influence entropy
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function whose total influence $I[f] = \sum_{i=1}^n \mathrm{Inf}_i[f]$ is strictly positive. Then
\[
  0 \;\le\; \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]}{I[f]}\,
    \log\!\left(\frac{I[f]}{\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]}\right),
\]
where $\log$ denotes the natural logarithm.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
total influence I[f] is strictly positive
replaced:
If $I[f] > 0$, then the entropy-like quantity attached to the influence distribution
is nonnegative:
\[
  0 \;\le\; \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]}{I[f]}\,
    \log\!\left(\frac{I[f]}{\mathrm{Inf}_i[f]}\right).
\]
